notes.title: A Major Update!
notes.content:
Hi there everybody!
It's been a while since the game was released, lots of stuff happened.
The game is now available on some Android consoles and we're impoved the Steam controller support.

Also, we're going to test it on Steam deck as soon as we have it! But, no any problems with Steam deck expected.

Some minor fixes were done on some levels; also Chinese translations are now better.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30651306/58b43958ace674e2886755c6c388a60e4996930b.gif[/img]
Cheers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30651306/fa1cdd3ab2ce75b0e507113101c34a0b834a78a4.gif[/img]

notes.title: Minor updates - improved Gamepad support, tutorial level and comics on Chinese
notes.content:
Hey everybody, thanks for playing the game! I've just updated it with a typo fixed in Chinese language and some improvements with XInput controller:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651306/801df2a813285530968ff58475744f78cd1420e1.png[/img]

Gamepad support wasn't my priority so it still uses the cursor to play the game.
Still better than nothing!

And, a couple of tutorial levels are now easier to pass through.

Best,
V

notes.title: Updated demo release
notes.content:
Hi there, we're just updated the demo on http://siegesaga.com/assets/downloads/siegesaga.zip - now including level editor and some new levels for playing! Subscribe on the official site http://siegesa.ga to know when the game is ready, including some new platforms!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651306/58b43958ace674e2886755c6c388a60e4996930b.gif[/img]

The level editor is kinda tricky to start though, so we will probably release a  video tutorial on Youtube.
